layouts.name: ಕೆಜಿಪಿ / ನುಡಿ
layouts.description: Phonetic layout (KPRao/KGP/Nudi family). Type by sound - k→ಕ, A→ಾ, f→್, M→ಂ.

layouts.name: ಇನ್‌ಸ್ಕ್ರಿಪ್ಟ್
layouts.description: Government-standard positional layout. Every key has a fixed letter; matches Windows/Linux Kannada InScript.

layouts.name: ಲಿಪ್ಯಂತರಣ
layouts.description: Roman-to-Kannada: type k→ಕ, ka→ಕಾ, kSa→ಕ್ಷ, Sh→ಷ. No physical layout to memorise.

layouts.name: ಇನ್‌ಸ್ಕ್ರಿಪ್ಟ್ ೨
layouts.description: Enhanced InScript variant with direct ZWJ/ZWNJ keys, ₹, and historic letters on the alternate layer.
